name: Inferno
caption: Won a battle-royal-qualified final by count-out to become WFW's first-ever Intercontinental Champion at Summernight Powerslam.

tenures.source: The fed's own 'Summernight Powerslam' supercard (5 July 1995); also defended the title in a non-title bout the fed's own 'Power Zone' broadcast two days later (read, not separately served this pass).

name: "Lunatic" Lenny Rose
caption: Co-winner of WFW's own Battle Royal at Summernight Powerslam, then lost the resulting final by count-out to Inferno for the vacant Intercontinental Championship.

tenures.source: The fed's own 'Summernight Powerslam' supercard (5 July 1995).

name: Johnny "the rebel" Banger
caption: Lost the WFW World Championship to the Ultimate Fighting Machine at Summernight Powerslam.

tenures.source: The fed's own 'Summernight Powerslam' supercard (5 July 1995); billed the incoming champion.

name: The Ultimate Fighting Machine
caption: Won the WFW World Championship from Johnny "the rebel" Banger at Summernight Powerslam and was still champion, defending it in a non-title bout, at the fed's own next broadcast.

tenures.source: The fed's own 'Summernight Powerslam' supercard (5 July 1995); also wrestled a non-title defense on the fed's own 'Power Zone' broadcast two days later (read, not separately served this pass).
